requirements.title: Pipelines publishes images in dependency order with digest pins
requirements.remaining: A release orchestration tool is on the default branch (scripts/release_orchestrator.py: validate, plan, publish, verify-consumers): candidate schema with cycle and floating-tag refusal, qualification, dependency-ordered publication that stops downstream on a failed stage, idempotent retry, and exact digest handoff, all tested against recorded fixtures. Remaining: the live adapters that push a revision, await hosted checks and publish images, and wiring the tool into the release workflow as an opt-in step.

requirements.title: Release build job sources environment values safely
requirements.remaining: Sourced environment values are read and exported safely (scripts/write_github_env.sh). A reproducibility check that builds a package twice and compares the wheels byte for byte is on the default branch (scripts/release_orchestrator.py check-reproducible-build), proven on a pure-Python fixture including a deliberately non-reproducible build. Remaining: run that check inside the real release build, including for the Rust-built wheels.
